data.title: Roof repair invoice from Dachdeckerei Muster
data.summary: Dachdeckerei Muster invoiced €569.53 for the storm damage roof repair done on 2 February 2026. Payment is requested within 10 calendar days of the invoice date (4 February 2026).
data.explanation: This is a bill for repairing your roof after the storm: 14 roof tiles replaced, labour and a lift platform. The total is €569.53 including 19% VAT. Pay within 10 calendar days of the invoice date by bank transfer, quoting the invoice number. The letter says partial payments are possible by arrangement, so contact the company if you need that. If you have a building insurance policy, you may want to check whether the storm damage is covered. Keep the invoice for your records.

items.quote: Bitte gleichen Sie diese Rechnung binnen 10 Kalendertagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum aus; Teilzahlungen sind nach Absprache möglich.
